title: Understanding Variance in the Model
text: Think about what the variance \( \sigma**2 \) represents in the context of a linear model. How does it relate to the randomness or noise in the data?

title: Exploring the Role of \( \sigma**2 \)
text: Consider the role of \( \sigma**2 \) in the equation \( Y_i=f_{\theta**{*}}(X_i)+\epsilon_i \). Is \( \sigma**2 \) a parameter that changes with each observation, or is it a fixed quantity that describes the overall variability?
